text:
incident-bot: 🚨 Pager: 5xx spike on /v1/generate in eu-west-1 - error rate 14% (p95 latency 2.4s)
deploy-bot: Detected rollout: deployment/redwood-encoder v2.4 -> v2.5
maya (oncall): I'm on it, diagnosing. Are we seeing any 503s or just 500s?
jon (sre): 500s with crashloop in redwood-encoder pod group. Logs show OOMKilled then readiness failures.
sasha (eng): We shipped a sidecar config rotation yesterday that injected NEW_ENV=1 into encoder pods. Rolling change included a readiness probe tweak.
maya (oncall): Copy. Can someone paste the failing container logs?
sasha (eng): Logs: ```
2026-03-15T12:02:11Z stderr: runtime error: unexpected EOF reading config
2026-03-15T12:02:12Z stderr: panic: failed to load sidecar config
... stack ...
``` 
jon (sre): HPA in cluster is scaling based on custom metric coming from sidecar. If sidecar crashes, metrics stop -> HPA kills/recreates -> crashloop.
liz (pm): Customer Support says ~30 customers in EU saw 500s starting ~12:01 UTC. No data exfiltration, just service errors.
maya (oncall): Immediate mitigation: rolling back deployment and toggling feature flag. @deploy-bot can you revert to v2.4 and flip feature flag encoder_v2=false?
deploy-bot: rollback initiated: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-encoder --to-revision=2` — status pending
deploy-bot: feature flag toggled: encoder_v2 = OFF (targeted rollout aborted)
jon (sre): Executed `kubectl get pods -l app=redwood-encoder -o wide` — new pods in Terminating state due to preStop delay (sidecar waiting on config-manager).
maya (oncall): Kill the stuck pods after graceful window. `kubectl delete pod <pod> --grace-period=0 --force` if they don't exit in 30s.
jon (sre): Did that. New replica sets from 2.4 are up. Error rate down to 1.2% and p95 ~420ms.
customer-support: Logged incident notes and messaged affected customers. Preparing a postmortem blurb for status page.
sasha (eng): Root cause: config-rotation script wrote partial JSON into sidecar volume when rolling update occurred concurrently with config-manager restart. Readiness probe mis-configured to 1s check — too aggressive during boot.
liz (pm): Action items: 1) revert sidecar rotation process to safe path; 2) increase readiness probe timeout; 3) add canary gating for config changes; 4) add HPA fallback metric. Assign owners?
maya (oncall): I'll own the immediate docs + oncall follow-up. jon takes remediation work with sasha. liz will coordinate customer comms.
maya (oncall): Handoff to next oncall in 30m. No open P0s. :white_check_mark:
